- **Target Audience:** Cloud engineers, DevOps engineers, SREs, and developers working with AWS and cloud infrastructure.

## Core Mission & Architecture
5GOOS develops focused, lightweight open-source utilities and web applications for modern cloud operations. Key design principles:
- **Zero Bloat:** Instant access with zero mandatory account sign-ups, email walls, or telemetry tracking.
- **High Signal:** Fast interfaces that answer specific operational questions immediately.
- **Open Source:** Permissive licenses, public GitHub repositories, and community-driven development.

## Flagship Project: BotoView

- **Product Name:** BotoView
- **Live Web Application:** https://botoview.5goos.com
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/5goos/botoview
- **Creator & Maintainer:** Naveen Thurimerla / 5GOOS
- **Category:** Cloud Operations / AWS SDK Tooling
- **Description:** The modern, lightning-fast AWS Boto3 & Botocore changelog explorer, release tracker, and service timeline. An interactive web application to track, filter, and inspect daily AWS Boto3 releases, service additions, API changes, and parameter updates.
- **Licensing:** Open Source
